name: ojix-premium-site
description: A responsive, light-first website for OJIX Engineering & Technology LLP. It uses the provided OJIX brand kit, with navy `#0F1C2E`, orange `#C9662F`, white and muted neutral surfaces. The layout and UI are original; Apple and Grok were treated as quality/clarity references rather than copied layouts.

scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.test: node --check server.js && node --check db.js && node --check store.js && npm run build
